what: Which face of the assembly each printed panel of set 6651557 is drawn from, for printed steps 1 to 43. Two raters read the rendered pages and answered a two-way forced choice per panel; neither was shown the rotate-the-model icon, the other's answers, or any face the pipeline had derived. Their per-panel verdicts and the feature each named are kept below, so the claim can be inspected rather than taken on the summary.
howToReadTheAgreement: interRaterAgreement alone is close to uninformative here and must be read against majorityClassShare: 38 of 43 panels are studs-up, so a rater who answered that every time would score 0.8837. The agreement is worth something only on the 5 minority panels, which are the ones the whole question is about.
